CASE NO. AVU-G-00-6 

AVU-E-00-11 

ORDER NO. 28613 

On November 13, 2000, Avista Corporation dba Avista Utilities—Washington Water 
Power Division (Idaho) made a filing with the Idaho Public Utilities Commission (Commission) 
requesting authority to add a new Section 6.3 to the Company’s Idaho Rules and Regulations: i.e., 
6.3 Service Establishment Charge 
When an account is initially established under any of the Rules and 
Regulations, a Customer will be required to pay a service establishment 
charge in the amount of $15.00. 

On December 22, 2000, the Commission issued a Notice of Application and 
Modified Procedure in Case Nos. AVU-G-00-6 and AVU-E-00-11. The deadline for filing 
written comments was January 12, 2001. 
On January 11, 2001, Avista Utilities, by letter filing with the Commission, requests 
withdrawal of its Application. Reference IDAPA 31.01.01.068. With recent rate activity 
brought on by the volatile wholesale electric and gas markets as well as other recent changes to 
Avista’s miscellaneous fee schedule, the Company is of the stated belief that another Schedule 
70/170 change is not appropriate at this time. 
COMMISSION FINDINGS 
The Commission has reviewed and considered the filings of record in Case 
Nos. AVU-G-00-6 and AVU-E-00-11. Good cause being shown, we find it reasonable to grant 
the Company’s request to withdraw its Application and to close the related case dockets. 
CONCLUSIONS OF LAW 
The Commission has jurisdiction over Avista Corporation dba Avista Utilities—
Washington Water Power Division (Idaho), a combination gas and electric utility, and the issues 

ORDER NO. 28613

presented in Case No. AVU-G-00-6 and AVU-E-00-11 pursuant to the authority granted in Idaho 
Code, Title 61 and the Commission’s Rules of Procedure, IDAPA 31.01.01.000 et seq. 
O R D E R 
In consideration of the foregoing and as more particularly described above, IT IS 
HEREBY ORDERED and the Commission does hereby grant the Company’s request to 
withdraw its Application in Case Nos. AVU-G-00-6 and AVU-E-00-11. Reference IDAPA 
31.01.01.068. 
IT IS FURTHER ORDERED that the dockets in said cases be closed. 
THIS IS A FINAL ORDER. Any person interested in this Order may petition for 
reconsideration within twenty-one (21) days of the service date of this Order. Within seven (7) 
days after any person has petitioned for reconsideration, any other person may cross-petition for 
reconsideration. See Idaho Code § 61-626. 
DONE by Order of the Idaho Public Utilities Commission at Boise, Idaho this 
day of January 2001. 

DENNIS S. HANSEN, PRESIDENT 

MARSHA H. SMITH, COMMISSIONER 

PAUL KJELLANDER, COMMISSIONER 

ATTEST: 

Jean D. Jewell 
Commission Secretary
